meta.claim: Synthetic capability test. qrels are graph-derived, so this measures whether a criterion of universal quantification and exact identity can execute the evidence relation, not human relevance. Constraints come from query metadata (type, symbols, module, chain); qrels is never read by the builder.

gate.rule: CESR-U beats CESR-code AND RRF on all@10 for text-unique queries at every budget where gold evidence fits in >=90% of queries (1000, 2000), and full coverage implies complete evidence at >= 0.90.
gate.verdict: universal/identity constraints rescue the evidence-set objective
